title.zh: 将达瑙市苏巴小学的名称变更为Severo Duterte纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Suba Elementary School in the City of Danao, to Severo Duterte Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Suba Elementary School in the City of Danao, to Severo Duterte Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Suba tại Thành phố Danao thành Trường tiểu học Severo Duterte Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Suba ในเมือง Danao เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Severo Duterte Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Suba di Kota Danao menjadi Sekolah Dasar Severo Duterte Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Suba di Bandaraya Danao menjadi Sekolah Rendah Severo Duterte Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5625_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Suba Elementary School in the City of Danao, is hereby changed to Severo Duterte Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
